voice_absent.title: Voice chat is an add-on
voice_absent.lead: Talk to a chat hands-free: DisPatch listens, works out when you have finished, and speaks the bot's reply back sentence by sentence. It all runs on this server's own processor, so nothing you say leaves the machine. Voice chat is a separate package, DisPatch Voice (MIT), so DisPatch itself stays small and installs without any speech software.

voice_absent.where_backend: On the server, in DisPatch's `backend` folder:
voice_absent.uv_sync_note: Running `uv sync` removes the add-on again; `dispatch-voice doctor` tells you when that happened.
voice_absent.checkout_hint: Install it editable, or add it to the `uv run` line your service starts DisPatch with:
voice_absent.step_models: 3. Download the speech models in Settings → Voice

host_notice.title: Saved on the DisPatch computer
host_notice.files_body: Files and pictures you upload or make here (in chats, the File Server, Image Studio and Settings) are saved on the computer that runs DisPatch, not on your device. Other profiles can't open them, except on the shared DisPatch profile. Anyone with access to that computer or its backups can.
host_notice.chats_body: Every chat is saved on the computer that runs DisPatch, not on this device, and is not end-to-end encrypted. A chat belongs to the profile it was had in: other profiles, Admins included, can't open it. The shared DisPatch profile is the exception: everyone who uses it sees its bots and chats. Agent bots run on that computer and can read anything on it, and so can anyone with access to that computer, its files or its backups.
